report.narrative: All 3 of 3 test cases passed. The core journeys — live setup without a camera, side-by-side comparison of two recordings, and one-button squat review with durable local history — are solid and working as specified. Users can navigate the full workflow without a camera, a paired phone, or any external account. Measurements, overlays, rep selection, phase navigation, and local session persistence (including rename-and-reload) all behaved correctly. Minor rough edges were noted across cases — the session diagnostics panel gives no visual hint it is expandable, the recorded-clip tab's empty video area has no placeholder, the reference-rep dropdown requires keyboard to confirm a selection, the video download link sits out of view in a collapsed panel, the selected reference rep resets after reopening a saved session, and a collapsible label is misleadingly named — but none of these block comprehension or task completion. No failures or blocked cases to report.
